hold.title: Total amount on hold
hold.hint: Money TikTok has NOT settled yet: Σ estimated settlement amount (est_settlement_amount) of unsettled transactions (Finance API). Current snapshot, not tied to the date range. Other currencies are listed separately, never converted.

shop.title: Shop status
shop.hint: Based on the TikTok shop status stored in the system: Live = ACTIVE; Die = INACTIVE (reported inactive by TikTok); Deauthorized = DEAUTHORIZED.

holdBySeller.title: On hold by seller
holdBySeller.hint: Hold grouped by the seller assigned to the TikTok account. Shop = shops with unsettled money. Every seller with a hold, descending.

period.title: Orders by period
period.hint: Orders placed in the period (operations time zone). Est. Rev = proceeds of those orders (settled, otherwise TikTok estimate). Payout = money TikTok paid out in the period. % versus the previous period.
period.noBaseline: No orders in the previous period — % not available

finance.title: Finance
finance.hint: Paid = money TikTok paid out (PAID payments) in the range. Processing = settled statements whose payment is still PROCESSING.

orders.title: Orders
orders.returnsUnavailable: No return data yet — no shop in this scope has synced TikTok Return & Refund successfully.
orders.returnsHint: {{requests}} return/refund request(s) · {{refunded}} order(s) refunded by TikTok. Amount = revenue reversed in settled statements (already included in Est. revenue / Profit).

sellers.title: Seller statistics
sellers.hint: Seller = employee assigned as seller of a TikTok account. Uses the shared date range and filters; On hold is the current snapshot.
sellers.returnsUnavailable: No return data yet — no shop in this scope has synced TikTok Return & Refund successfully.

colHint.revenue: Per-order proceeds: the settled amount for settled orders, otherwise the TikTok estimate. Each order counts once.
colHint.baseCost: Base cost confirmed by the fulfillment provider for the fulfillment currently holding the order (a resubmission replaces the old one).
colHint.shippingFee: Σ Seller Shipping Fee of each order — the shipping cost the seller actually bears (same value as the Order screen): settled orders use the shipping cost TikTok deducted, unsettled ones the TikTok-charged estimate or the seller-funded shipping discount. Each order counts once; orders whose shipping fee is not known yet are not summed (not treated as 0).
colHint.label: Label = fulfilled orders × label cost per order. Unfulfilled / cancelled fulfillments are excluded.
colHint.profit: Est. profit = Revenue − Base cost − Shipping Fee − Label, computed on the row totals. Shipping is never subtracted twice: the part of Shipping Fee TikTok has ALREADY deducted from Revenue (settled orders / estimates that include shipping) is not subtracted again. Unconfirmed base cost counts as 0 (as in the Basecost column).
colHint.currentProfit: Current Profit = Paid − Basecost − Label − Seller Shipping Fee, using the seller's totals for the date range (Paid by payout date, the other columns by order date). Note: Paid is TikTok's payout, already net of the shipping TikTok charged.
colHint.paid: Money TikTok paid out in the range.
colHint.processing: Settled but not paid out yet (payment PROCESSING).
colHint.hold: Money TikTok has not settled yet (current).

sellers.returnsHint: Orders with an open or completed return/refund request (cancelled / rejected requests excluded). — = not synced yet.
sellers.partialHint: Only these orders have complete data; the rest have no finance / cost data yet and are NOT summed (not treated as 0).

holdShops.title: Shops with money on hold
holdShops.description: Money TikTok has not settled yet, per shop — same source, scope and currency as the "Total amount on hold" card.
holdShops.empty: No shop has money on hold.

shopList.title: {{status}} shops
shopList.description: Based on the TikTok shop status stored in the system, same scope as the "Shop status" card.
